notes: Primary care and same-day urgent care at 21 clinics across Manhattan, Brooklyn and Queens. Bond Vet's own site describes its urgent care as for problems that are not life-threatening - diarrhea, wounds, rashes, coughing. For anything life-threatening, or at night, go to a hospital open around the clock instead. Each clinic has its own text line on its page.
